body:
## Parent

Part of #73: Correct F07 and downstream evidence freeze to one Matchweek-wide cutoff.

## What to build

One corrected candidate chain can build through F11–F16 while T is open and #75 reports that no Matchweek selection exists. #75 seals that complete manifest once before T; only outputs named by the seal qualify as the recommendations. Once selected, and always after T, new evidence/input/model/decision work stops. All direct APIs and resume paths then replay the exact selection from #75.

## Scope

- F11 research acquisition and request/replay boundary.
- F12 attempts and their F11 lineage; weather and workload retrieval.
- F13 history/calibration/input selection and results; F14 decisions.
- F15 run inputs/resume and F16 membership coverage/manifest processing.
- Direct repository/service entry points as well as CLI orchestration.
- Existing F07/F06 policy-dispatch compatibility; use the owner delivered by #75.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Before selection, prospective F15/F16 candidate work requires #74's corrected rule, #75's preselection-write gate, and an open T. This permits the first complete candidate F16 manifest to be built for #75 to seal. An unselected candidate is not published as a recommendation.
- [x] #75 seals one complete candidate before T. After selection, and in every case after T, new collection/retrieval/retention, F11 request variants, F13 mutable history/calibration discovery, F14 decision assembly, or F16 manifest construction refuses; only exact selected outputs replay. An old/early `published_at` cannot authorize late retrieval.
- [x] Exercise gate checks at each direct writer and resume boundary, not only in the CLI. Weather/location/rule changes, UNKNOWN/failure metadata, later history/outcomes, changed profile/policy, missing-phase resume, or second manifests cannot create another prospective recommendation state.
- [x] Before T, F11 evidence uses the exact policy/common cutoff for every INCLUDED member and known `published_at <= retrieved_at <= T`. All seven scopes receive the same frozen evidence state.
- [x] F13/F14/F15/F16 validate the selected F11/F13/F14 dependency closure, exact F06 revisions, homogeneous common boundary, and complete INCLUDED coverage. Different digests or equal timestamps under different identities are refused.
- [x] Preserve old request/result/policy bytes and replay across supported F11/F13/F14/F16 readers. A global F13 engine/research-adapter bump must not break old replay; version-dispatch if a change is unavoidable.
- [x] Focused regression tests cover direct-writer gates and post-T exact replay in F11/F12/F13/F14/F15/F16, plus legacy golden identities and reopening/replay. Include changed requests, late-attempt metadata, mutable history, partial runs, mixed boundaries, and exact resume.
- [x] Run only those focused tests, Ruff for changed Python, and `git diff --check`.

## Blocked by

- #75 — it supplies the selection owner and preselection-write gate that downstream writers call. Its dependency on #74 ensures the gate sees the corrected whole-freeze boundary.

Tests may use isolated temporary stores and deterministic local fixtures only. Do not open or modify either live SQLite store, acquire current fixtures or network data, publish live F artifacts, or send a Sigstore/RFC3161 request. Do not mutate historical F11/F13/F14/F16 artifacts, released migrations, issues, or `.audit` evidence.

comments.body:
Implemented and pushed to main in 53bb02c6d60897ebd9510594ee9c55a5a73a49a9.

F11–F16 direct prospective writers and partial-run resume call the shared #75 authority. Corrected work requires the exact common boundary and contract, no selection, and a trusted UTC upper bound strictly before T. At selection or T, these paths refuse new recommendation state and replay only exact selected references. Later audit metadata cannot change the frozen lineage. Default production time remains untrusted and fails closed.

Verification passed: all 25 issue-focused cases on final code, affected F11–F16/#75 regressions, historical identity/golden checks, and archived-source replay of 30 byte-identical legacy artifacts with zero catalog writes. Ruff, formatting, strict mypy and staged diff checks passed. Independent blast-radius and cross-model trail reviews found no unresolved functional blocker. Evidence and the append-only decision trail are committed in `.audit/issue-76-implementation/`.

No schema migration, payload redesign or historical engine identity change was needed. #73, #77 and #78 remain open. Closing #76 allows #77 to become unblocked normally; #77 has not been started. The live trusted-clock confidence problem remains outside this issue.

title: Enforce the selected cutoff across F11–F16 writers and replay
